question: In which of the following countries is the Sri Pada mountain located?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sri Lanka.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sri Pada mountain is located in Sri Lanka.**
 
• Sri Pada is the second highest mountain in Sri Lanka.
 
• It is also known as Adam's Peak.
 
• It is a 2,243 m tall conical mountain located in central Sri Lanka.
